item.title:
The You Can Just Build Things commercial was excellent.

We’re in this strange moment where the gap between idea and execution has completely collapsed. That thing you keep saying someone should build this about? You can build it now.

You’re not waiting on a developer. You’re not waiting on funding. The only thing between you and the thing you want to exist is deciding to start.

That’s what made it excellent. It was just true.
